# Commands console reliability, hidden browser, and review-queue workflows

`saveLocalKnowledgeHistory()` must not call `store.all()` for a large corpus. Use one fixed `throughRowid = store.maxRecordRowid()`, page `store.recordIds({ afterRowid, throughRowid })`, and `store.get()` only for IDs absent from Git; preserve canonical immutable-file checks, the history lock, append-only history, and one final commit. `test/knowledge-history.test.mjs` covered bounded pages and fixed snapshot boundaries (18 focused tests passed). [Task 14]

Scope: console.
